title: BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 - Apply for Project Research Scientist I Posts
description: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani (BITS Pilani) has issued the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for Project Research Scientist I Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in any degree or postgraduation can grab this chance and apply for the BITS Pilani Recruitment 202 6 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested candidates can apply before the last...
